{{recipe}}

[http://www.foodista.com/recipe/L8NNR2S4/gluten-free-quinoa-vegetable-slaw-with-peanut-dressing Originally posted to Foodista] by user Simmer + Sauce. Foodista recipes are released under a [http://www.foodista.com/static/legal CC-BY license].

==Ingredients==

=== Peanut dressing ===
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] lightly roasted creamy [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Tamari|tamari]]
* 3 tablespoons rice [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* 3 teaspoons tossed [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|sesame oil]]
* 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]] juice
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Chili garlic sauce|chili garlic sauce]]
* 1 tablespoon cold water
* ¼ cup roasted and salted [[Cookbook:Peanut|peanuts]], roughly [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

=== Salad ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] cooked black [[Cookbook:Quinoa|quinoa]], cooled
* 3 cups shredded purple [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]]
* ¾ cup shredded [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Green Onion|scallions]], thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 6 mini red [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]], thinly sliced
* ½ cup loosely packed [[Cookbook:Cilantro|cilantro]] leaves
==Procedure==

=== Dressing ===
#In a small mixing bowl add the peanut butter, tamari, rice vinegar, sesame oil, lime juice, chili sauce and water. 
#[[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] the dressing until well incorporated.

=== Salad ===
#Cook the quinoa per the package instructions and cool. Set aside.
#In a large mixing bowl add the cabbage, carrots, scallions, red peppers and cilantro leaves. Using your hands, lightly [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] and set aside.
#To serve, mix in the cooled, cooked quinoa with the vegetable mixture the and chopped peanuts. Drizzle with the peanut dressing and gently toss to incorporate. Serve immediately.
